name: Zhizi Capture Bridge

transport.note: This is intentionally not private Owner Plane MCP and not formal MCP/SSE yet. Treat these endpoints as low-permission tools callable by the EAZO/Zhizi Capture Agent. A later MCP/SSE wrapper can map these tools 1:1 after TLS/auth hardening.

auth.note: Do not ask the user to paste a static token into the App. Submit public-safe turns without a shared secret; Zhizi computes a dynamic grant/demotion state from the interaction and payload risk.

production_readiness.current_scope: private/staging EAZO-Zhizi iteration with low-permission payloads

tools.name: zhizi.submit_intent
tools.purpose: Send a user intent or agent turn to Zhizi for durable receipt and fleet/frontstage triage.

tools.name: zhizi.submit_feedback
tools.purpose: Submit a Zhizi Capture feedback item, client error, or bug report for Fleet repair triage.

tools.name: zhizi.attach_context
tools.purpose: Attach follow-up public-safe context to a prior receipt.

tools.name: zhizi.poll_status
tools.purpose: Poll a receipt for status, history, and eventual Zhizi reply.

tools.name: zhizi.read_blackboard
tools.purpose: Read the public-safe blackboard state mirrored from the relay.

safety_boundary: Use this as an agent-readable mailbox and receipt loop, not as a raw tool-execution endpoint.
Do not use or request a static pairing token. Low-permission intake is tokenless; higher authority requires interaction-based grants and remains owner/frontstage gated.
Do not send passwords, API keys, cookies, verification codes, payment data, identity documents, private source code, or owner-private transcripts.
Requests are capped at 16384 bytes and rate-limited per source IP before storage.

Zhizi may create internal tasks, memory/dashboard candidates, or owner-gated decision packets. External sends, spending, account changes, deletion, legal/medical/contract commitments, and private Owner Plane access require separate approval.
HTTP transport is staging-only; broad app use is blocked until HTTPS/TLS is added.

loop_closure.receipt: submit_intent returns receipt_id and dynamic_grant immediately.
loop_closure.durable_state: Tokyo relay stores append-only receipt records and mirrors public-safe projections to GitHub.
loop_closure.feedback: EAZO Agent polls status_url or GitHub blackboard; Zhizi replies appear in receipt.reply when available.
loop_closure.timeout: If no reply appears, the status remains received/triage state instead of silently failing.
loop_closure.repair: Client should surface non-2xx JSON errors and retry only after changing the offending payload.
